title: Stability of vertically charged steady magnetic field in 3D incompressible magneto-micropolar fluids without magnetic and angular viscosity in a strip domain
summary: This paper intends to understand the regularity and stability problem on the 3D incompressible magneto-micropolar equations with zero magnetic and angular viscosities in a strip domain. The magneto-micropolar system models the electrically conducting micropolar fluid in the presence of a magnetic field. The lack of magnetic diffusion and angular dissipation makes it impossible to prove even small data global well-posedness result, let alone general large data global regularity.
